description: Source code for HiveThriftServer2AppStatusStore class and related classes, providing a view of a key-value store with methods to query SQL-specific state in Spark's Hive Thrift Server UI.

classes.name: HiveThriftServer2AppStatusStore
classes.description: Provides methods to query and retrieve session and execution information from a KVStore.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Represents session details including session ID, timestamps, IP, username, and total executions.

classes.name: ExecutionInfo
classes.description: Represents execution details including execution ID, statement, session ID, timestamps, execution plan, state, job IDs, and group ID.

methods.name: getSessionList
methods.description: Returns a sequence of all session information objects.

methods.name: getExecutionList
methods.description: Returns a sequence of all execution information objects.

methods.name: getOnlineSessionNum
methods.description: Returns the number of currently active sessions (not finished).

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves session info by session ID, if exists.

methods.name: getExecution
methods.description: Retrieves execution info by execution ID, if exists.

methods.name: getTotalRunning
methods.description: Counts the number of currently active executions.
